ABOUT • BIOGRAPHY

The Architect

PORTRAIT

Shreyas B J CHIKKAMAGALURU • BANGALORE

Rooted in the calm terrains of Chikkamagaluru and tempered in the high-velocity technological core of Bangalore, I am an AI/ML Engineer at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) with a rigorous foundation in Electronics & Communication Engineering from Nagarjuna College of Engineering and Technology (graduating with an 8.89 CGPA). My engineering intuition was forged on industrial failure analysis lines at Foxconn (Hon Hai Technology Group), where I conducted root-cause failure investigations, traced electrical schematics, and diagnosed microscopic circuit anomalies under stringent manufacturing tolerances. Today, I translate that forensic hardware discipline into building high-performance machine learning models, deploying computer vision inference pipelines, and orchestrating multi-agent LLM systems certified by Databricks, Anthropic Claude, and Google Cloud Gemini—all while continuously grounding my perception through a lifelong discipline of observational fine-art sketching that bridges physical observation with synthetic machine intelligence.

"Observing reality with forensic precision—whether through a microscope on an SMT production line or graphite on cold-pressed paper."
#AI/ML #ComputerVision #HardwareReliability #Databricks #FineArtSketching
